BiblicalUsage: gᵉnaz is the word for treasure. I meet it 3 times across the Bible, and Ezra is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gᵉnaz matters because what I treasure shows what I worship. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
